module XML2DSL;
create OUT : DSL from IN : XML;

helper context XML!Element def: getAttrBool(name : String) : Boolean =
	if self.hasAttr(name) then
		self.getAttrVal(name) = 'true'
	else
		false
	endif;

helper context XML!Element def: getAttrVal(name : String) : String =
	let attr : XML!Attribute = self.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Attribute) and c.name = name)->first() in
	if attr.oclIsUndefined() then
		''
	else
		attr.value
	endif;

helper context XML!Element def: get(name : String) : XML!Element =
	self.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element) and c.name = name)->first();

helper context XML!Element def: getType() : String =
	let typeElem : XML!Element = self.get('ValuePropertyHasType') in
	if typeElem.oclIsUndefined() then
		''
	else
		let child : XML!Element = typeElem.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
		if child.oclIsUndefined() then
			''
		else
			if child.hasAttr('Id') then
				child.getAttrVal('Id')
			else
				child.getAttrVal('Name')
			endif
		endif
	endif;

helper context XML!Element def: getEnumId() : String =
	let enumElem : XML!Element = self.get('EnumerationLiteralHasValue') in
	if enumElem.oclIsUndefined() then
		''
	else
		let child : XML!Element = enumElem.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
		if child.oclIsUndefined() then
			''
		else
			child.getAttrVal('Id')
		endif
	endif;

helper context XML!Element def: getText() : String =
	let textNode : XML!Text = self.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Text))->first() in
	if textNode.oclIsUndefined() then
		''
	else
		textNode.value
	endif;

helper context XML!Element def: getSeq(name : String) : Sequence(XML!Element) =
	let child : XML!Element = self.get(name) in
	if child.oclIsUndefined() then
		Sequence {}
	else
		child.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))
	endif;

helper context XML!Element def: hasChildren() : Boolean =
	self.children->exists(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element));

helper context XML!Element def: hasAttr(name : String) : Boolean =
	self.children->exists(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Attribute) and c.name = name);

helper context XML!Element def: isAbstract() : Boolean =
	self.getAttrBool('isAbstract');

helper def: dslElementsById : Map(String, XML!Element) =
	XML!Element.allInstances()->select(e | e.hasAttr('Id'))->iterate(e; acc : Map(String, XML!Element) = Map {} |
		acc.insert(e.getAttrVal('Id'), e)
	);

helper def: getSubTypes(id : String) : Sequence(XML!Element) =
	XML!Element.allInstances()->select(e | e.name = 'Class' or e.name = 'Relationship')->select(e |
		let inheritance : XML!Element = e.get('ClassHasBaseClass') in
		if inheritance.oclIsUndefined() then
			let relInheritance : XML!Element = e.get('DomainRelationshipHasBaseDomainRelationship') in
			if relInheritance.oclIsUndefined() then
				false
			else
				let base : XML!Element = relInheritance.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
				if base.oclIsUndefined() then false else base.getAttrVal('Id') = id endif
			endif
		else
			let base : XML!Element = inheritance.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
			if base.oclIsUndefined() then false else base.getAttrVal('Id') = id endif
		endif
	);

helper def: findType(id : String) : DSL!Type =
	let elem : XML!Element = thisModule.dslElementsById.get(id) in
	if elem.oclIsUndefined() then
		DSL!SimpleType.allInstances()->select(t | t.name = id or t.identity = id)->first()
	else
		elem
	endif;

rule DomainModel {
	from
		s : XML!Element (
			s.name = 'DomainModel'
		)
	to
		t : DSL!DomainModel (
			name <- s.getAttrVal('name'),
			namespace <- s.getAttrVal('namespace'),
			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),
			isLoaded <- true,
			types <- Sequence {stringType, booleanType, integerType, doubleType}->union(s.getSeq('Types')),
			classifiers <- s.getSeq('Classes')->union(s.getSeq('Relationships'))
		),
		stringType : DSL!SimpleType (
			name <- 'String',
			namespace <- s.getAttrVal('namespace'),
			identity <- 'String'
		),
		booleanType : DSL!SimpleType (
			name <- 'Boolean',
			namespace <- s.getAttrVal('namespace'),
			identity <- 'Boolean'
		),
		integerType : DSL!SimpleType (
			name <- 'Integer',
			namespace <- s.getAttrVal('namespace'),
			identity <- 'Integer'
		),
		doubleType : DSL!SimpleType (
			name <- 'Double',
			namespace <- s.getAttrVal('namespace'),
			identity <- 'Double'
		)
}

rule Class {
	from
		s : XML!Element (
			s.name = 'Class'
		)
	to
		t : DSL!Class (
			name <- s.getAttrVal('name'),
			namespace <- s.getAttrVal('namespace'),
			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),
			isLoaded <- true,
			isAbstract <- s.isAbstract(),
			domainModel <- s.parent.parent,
			properties <- s.getSeq('Properties'),
			superType <- let inheritance : XML!Element = s.get('ClassHasBaseClass') in
				if inheritance.oclIsUndefined() then
					OclUndefined
				else
					let base : XML!Element = inheritance.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
					if base.oclIsUndefined() then
						OclUndefined
					else
						thisModule.dslElementsById.get(base.getAttrVal('Id'))
					endif
				endif,
			subTypes <- thisModule.getSubTypes(s.getAttrVal('Id'))
		)
}

rule Relationship {
	from
		s : XML!Element (
			s.name = 'Relationship'
		)
	to
		t : DSL!Relationship (
			name <- s.getAttrVal('name'),
			namespace <- s.getAttrVal('namespace'),
			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),
			isLoaded <- true,
			isAbstract <- s.isAbstract(),
			isEmbedding <- s.getAttrBool('isEmbedding'),
			domainModel <- s.parent.parent,
			properties <- s.getSeq('Properties'),
			roles <- s.getSeq('Roles'),
			superType <- let inheritance : XML!Element = s.get('DomainRelationshipHasBaseDomainRelationship') in
				if inheritance.oclIsUndefined() then
					OclUndefined
				else
					let base : XML!Element = inheritance.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
					if base.oclIsUndefined() then
						OclUndefined
					else
						thisModule.dslElementsById.get(base.getAttrVal('Id'))
					endif
				endif,
			subTypes <- thisModule.getSubTypes(s.getAttrVal('Id'))
		)
}

rule Role {
	from
		s : XML!Element (
			s.name = 'Role'
		)
	to
		t : DSL!Role (
			name <- s.getAttrVal('name'),
			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),
			min <- s.getAttrVal('min').toInteger(),
			max <- s.getAttrVal('max').toInteger(),
			isUnbounded <- s.getAttrBool('isUnbounded'),
			accepts <- s.getAttrVal('accepts'),
			isOrdered <- s.getAttrBool('isOrdered'),
			isNavigableFrom <- s.getAttrBool('isNavigableFrom'),
			isPropertyGenerator <- s.getAttrBool('isPropertyGenerator'),
			relation <- s.parent.parent,
			source <- let rel : XML!Element = s.parent.parent in
				let otherRoles : Sequence(XML!Element) = rel.getSeq('Roles')->excluding(s) in
				if otherRoles.isEmpty() then
					OclUndefined
				else
					let otherRole : XML!Element = otherRoles->first() in
					let typeElem : XML!Element = otherRole.get('DomainRoleAcceptsType') in
					if typeElem.oclIsUndefined() then
						OclUndefined
					else
						let child : XML!Element = typeElem.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
						if child.oclIsUndefined() then
							OclUndefined
						else
							thisModule.dslElementsById.get(child.getAttrVal('Id'))
						endif
					endif
				endif,
			type <- let typeElem : XML!Element = s.get('DomainRoleAcceptsType') in
				if typeElem.oclIsUndefined() then
					OclUndefined
				else
					let child : XML!Element = typeElem.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
					if child.oclIsUndefined() then
						OclUndefined
					else
						thisModule.dslElementsById.get(child.getAttrVal('Id'))
					endif
				endif
		)
}

rule ValueProperty {
	from
		s : XML!Element (
			s.name = 'ValueProperty'
		)
	to
		t : DSL!ValueProperty (
			name <- s.getAttrVal('name'),
			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),
			owner <- s.parent.parent,
			type <- thisModule.findType(s.getType())
		)
}

rule Enumeration {
	from
		s : XML!Element (
			s.name = 'Enumeration'
		)
	to
		t : DSL!Enumeration (
			name <- s.getAttrVal('name'),
			namespace <- s.getAttrVal('namespace'),
			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),
			literals <- s.getSeq('Literals')
		)
}

rule EnumerationLiteral {
	from
		s : XML!Element (
			s.name = 'EnumerationLiteral'
		)
	to
		t : DSL!EnumerationLiteral (
			name <- s.getAttrVal('name'),
			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),
			value <- if s.hasAttr('value') then s.getAttrVal('value').toInteger() else 0 endif
		)
}

					let base : XML!Element = inheritance.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
					if base.oclIsUndefined() then
						OclUndefined
					else
						thisModule.dslElementsById.get(base.getAttrVal('Id'))
					endif
				endif,
			subTypes <- thisModule.getSubTypes(s.getAttrVal('Id'))
		)
}

rule Relationship {
	from
		s : XML!Element (

		)
	to

			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),

			isAbstract <- s.isAbstract(),

}

rule Role {
	from
		s : XML!Element (
			s.name = 'Role'
		)
	to
		t : DSL!Role (
			name <- s.getAttrVal('name'),
			identity <- s.getAttrVal('Id'),
			min <- s.getAttrVal('min').toInteger(),
			max <- s.getAttrVal('max').toInteger(),
			isUnbounded <- s.getAttrBool('isUnbounded'),
			accepts <- s.getAttrVal('accepts'),
			isOrdered <- s.getAttrBool('isOrdered'),
			isNavigableFrom <- s.getAttrBool('isNavigableFrom'),
			isPropertyGenerator <- s.getAttrBool('isPropertyGenerator'),
			relation <- s.parent.parent,
			source <- let rel : XML!Element = s.parent.parent in
				let otherRoles : Sequence(XML!Element) = rel.getSeq('Roles')->excluding(s) in
				if otherRoles.isEmpty() then
					OclUndefined
				else
					let otherRole : XML!Element = otherRoles->first() in
					let typeElem : XML!Element = otherRole.get('DomainRoleAcceptsType') in
					if typeElem.oclIsUndefined() then
						OclUndefined
					else
						let child : XML!Element = typeElem.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
						if child.oclIsUndefined() then
							OclUndefined
						else
							thisModule.dslElementsById.get(child.getAttrVal('Id'))
						endif
					endif
				endif,
			type <- let typeElem : XML!Element = s.get('DomainRoleAcceptsType') in
				if typeElem.oclIsUndefined() then
					OclUndefined
				else
					let child : XML!Element = typeElem.children->select(c | c.oclIsKindOf(XML!Element))->first() in
					if child.oclIsUndefined() then
						OclUndefined
					else
						thisModule.dslElementsById.get(child.getAttrVal('Id'))
					endif
				endif
		)
}
